query_sql: SELECT event_status, COUNT(*) FROM campaign_interactions WHERE campaign_id='CMP001' GROUP BY event_status;
SELECT campaign_id, SUM(revenue_attributed) FROM campaign_interactions GROUP BY campaign_id;
SELECT lifecycle_stage, AVG(churn_risk_score) FROM customers GROUP BY lifecycle_stage;
SELECT category_affinity, COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE replenishment_due_score>=0.62 AND consent_marketing='Y' GROUP BY category_affinity;
SELECT agent_id, status, COUNT(*) FROM agent_runs WHERE agent_id='TASK_SA_FOLLOWUP_TASKING' GROUP BY status;
SELECT issue_type, COUNT(*) FROM service_tickets WHERE resolution_status IN ('Open','Escalated') GROUP BY issue_type;
SELECT campaign_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_status='suppressed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/COUNT(*) FROM campaign_interactions GROUP BY campaign_id;
SELECT agent_id, AVG(CASE WHEN status='success' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM agent_runs GROUP BY agent_id;
SELECT agent_id, MAX(latency_ms) FROM agent_runs GROUP BY agent_id;
SELECT scenario_id, COUNT(*) FROM agent_runs WHERE status='policy_blocked' GROUP BY scenario_id;
